name: Krista Carson Elhai
office: Claremont Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Krista Carson Elhai was the theatre director at Claremont High School from 1994 to 2021 and serves as president of the Educational Theatre Association board. Her campaign says she wants to address declining enrollment, plan beyond a single budget year, recruit and retain educators, and make board meetings more transparent.
